create.name: Dan Harris
create.bio:
Dan Harris is an American writer and meditation advocate who came to the practice from an unlikely place: two decades in television news at ABC, where he reported from conflict zones and co-anchored the weekend edition of Good Morning America. A very public moment of overwhelm on live television sent him looking for ways to steady his mind, and his sceptical investigation of Buddhist meditation became the bestselling memoir 10% Happier. A practical companion, Meditation for Fidgety Skeptics, written with the teacher Jeff Warren, followed.

His approach is plain-spoken and funny, aimed at people who assume meditation is not for them. He presents mindfulness, loving-kindness and open awareness as trainable skills rather than beliefs, and leans on long conversations with experienced teachers from the Insight and Tibetan traditions. He hosts the long-running 10% Happier podcast, leads weekly live sits and question sessions inside his own meditation app, and shares a few free guided practices on his website. At Omega Institute in Rhinebeck, New York, he co-leads a lively group retreat with Sebene Selassie and Jeff Warren that mixes sitting, movement and a good deal of laughter.

books.title: 10% Happier: How I Tamed the Voice in My Head, Reduced Stress Without Losing My Edge, and Found Self-Help That Actually Works (10th Anniversary Edition)
books.author: Dan Harris
books.description: A newsroom memoir that follows a hard-driving television reporter from scepticism to a daily sitting practice, meeting teachers, scientists and self-help figures along the way. This anniversary edition adds a fresh preface and a longer appendix of guided practices for beginners.

books.title: Meditation for Fidgety Skeptics: A 10% Happier How-to Book
books.author: Dan Harris, Jeff Warren, Carlye Adler
books.description: Harris and the teacher Jeff Warren travel across the United States meeting people who have given up on meditating, and answer their objections one by one. Each chapter ends with a short, practical exercise that can be fitted into a busy day.

courses.title: Meditation Party
courses.description: A three-day group retreat on Omega's Rhinebeck campus led with fellow teachers Sebene Selassie and Jeff Warren. Expect plenty of sitting practice from three different angles, along with movement, rest and conversation; it is deliberately not a silent retreat and suits beginners as well as seasoned meditators.

courses.title: 10% with Dan Harris (meditation app)
courses.description: His membership app, with a library of guided sessions from a range of teachers, weekly live sits with question time, structured practice challenges, a members' community and the podcast without adverts. A free trial is offered, and cost-free access is available on request for those who cannot pay.
courses.price: $10 USD per month or $99 USD per year

free_resources.title: Free guided meditations
free_resources.description: Six short audio practices he recorded himself and offers to stream on his website: basic breath awareness, a body scan, open awareness, loving-kindness and two kinds of walking practice. A simple starting set for anyone new to sitting.
